note: USACE Saylorville Lake, east side: 'the oldest and most popular campground on the lake', on a compact wooded ridge. --Claude
summary: Rate 24 confirmed, high 24 -> 26; count 125 -> 118 bookable; derived max 72 cleared (catalog has no such length); 100% by reservation, 14 max; facilities confirmed. Pin fine. Waterfront lead UP to lakeview from official site photos.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD UP: not waterfront -> lakeview under the filtered-view rule (AWH 2026-11-01). rec.gov's site photos show open lake through the trees from 072, 074, 109, 111, and nearly unscreened from 039 and 041 at the campground's south tip. Imagery: pads about 150-230 m from the shoreline, through woods then a shoreline band of brush (scaled from plotted per-site coordinates), so not on-water. The note's 'set back from the water (not waterfront)' goes with this. Below-dam check: this is on the lake side, upstream of the dam.

MAX RIG: stored 72 (from note prose 'rec.gov per-site max length 40-72 ft') is not in today's catalog, which is blank for 118 sites. Cleared. No site's listed length is under 28 ft; fit for 23 ft is not in doubt on this data, but it rests on only 7 listed sites.
